title: "First Stage Analysis Outputs"

Converted from the original R workflow script so the dissertation repository uses R Markdown workflow artefacts.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(lubridate)
  library(scales)
  library(broom)
})

base_dir <- "/Users/lu_nanxi/CASA/Dissertation_Data"
context_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "context_data")
cutoff_context_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Vivacity_full_day_cutoff_20260526", "context")

daily_with_index <- file.path(
  cutoff_context_dir,
  "vivacity_daily_lsoa2021_context_with_ltp3_index_to_2026-05-26.csv"
)

daily_context <- file.path(
  cutoff_context_dir,
  "vivacity_daily_lsoa2021_context_analysis_to_2026-05-26.csv"
)

input_daily <- if (file.exists(daily_with_index)) daily_with_index else daily_context

output_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Vivacity_R_outputs", "first_stage_analysis")
plot_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
table_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))

sensor_daily <- readr::read_csv(input_daily, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    week_date = as_date(week_date),
    month_date = as_date(month_date),
    intervention_date = as_date(intervention_date),
    first_reliable_date = as_date(first_reliable_date),
    imd_decile = as.numeric(imd_decile),
    income_decile = as.numeric(income_decile),
    active_travel_total = as.numeric(active_travel_total),
    pedestrian = as.numeric(pedestrian),
    cyclist = as.numeric(cyclist),
    car = as.numeric(car),
    imd_group = case_when(
      imd_decile <= 3 ~ "More deprived (IMD 1-3)",
      imd_decile >= 7 ~ "Less deprived (IMD 7-10)",
      TRUE ~ "Middle (IMD 4-6)"
    ),
    imd_group = factor(
      imd_group,
      levels = c("More deprived (IMD 1-3)", "Middle (IMD 4-6)", "Less deprived (IMD 7-10)")
    ),
    route_group = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(route_type), "path|cycle") ~ "Path/cycle facility",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(route_type), "road") ~ "Road",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    scheme_label = paste0(scheme_id, " - ", road_group),
    period_model = case_when(
      date < intervention_date ~ "pre",
      date >= intervention_date %m+% months(1) ~ "post",
      TRUE ~ "transition"
    )
  )

write_csv(
  sensor_daily,
  file.path(table_dir, "analysis_daily_with_deprivation_groups.csv")
)

scheme_readiness <- sensor_daily |>
  group_by(scheme_id, scheme_label, road_group, installation_month, intervention_date) |>
  summarise(
    countlines = n_distinct(countline_id),
    lsoa21_areas = n_distinct(analysis_lsoa21cd),
    lsoa21_names = paste(sort(unique(analysis_lsoa21nm)), collapse = "; "),
    local_authorities = paste(sort(unique(LAD22NM)), collapse = "; "),
    imd_decile_min = min(imd_decile, na.rm = TRUE),
    imd_decile_max = max(imd_decile, na.rm = TRUE),
    imd_groups = paste(sort(unique(as.character(imd_group))), collapse = "; "),
    first_observed_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_observed_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    pre_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "pre"]),
    post_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "post"]),
    transition_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "transition"]),
    pre_countline_days = sum(period_model == "pre", na.rm = TRUE),
    post_countline_days = sum(period_model == "post", na.rm = TRUE),
    active_travel_total = sum(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyclist_total = sum(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    pedestrian_total = sum(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_active_per_countline_day = mean(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    analysis_use = case_when(
      pre_calendar_days >= 60 & post_calendar_days >= 180 ~ "Exploratory pre/post ITS candidate",
      pre_calendar_days > 0 & post_calendar_days > 0 ~ "Limited pre/post descriptive only",
      post_calendar_days > 0 ~ "Post-installation trajectory only",
      TRUE ~ "Needs manual review"
    )
  )

write_csv(scheme_readiness, file.path(table_dir, "scheme_analysis_readiness.csv"))

sensor_readiness <- sensor_daily |>
  group_by(
    scheme_id, scheme_label, countline_id, countline_name, route_group,
    analysis_lsoa21cd, analysis_lsoa21nm, LAD22NM, imd_decile, imd_group,
    installation_month, intervention_date, first_reliable_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    first_observed_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_observed_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    pre_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "pre"]),
    post_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "post"]),
    transition_calendar_days = n_distinct(date[period_model == "transition"]),
    active_travel_total = sum(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyclist_total = sum(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    pedestrian_total = sum(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_active_per_day = mean(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    analysis_use = case_when(
      pre_calendar_days >= 60 & post_calendar_days >= 180 ~ "Exploratory pre/post ITS candidate",
      pre_calendar_days > 0 & post_calendar_days > 0 ~ "Limited pre/post descriptive only",
      post_calendar_days > 0 ~ "Post-installation trajectory only",
      TRUE ~ "Needs manual review"
    )
  )

write_csv(sensor_readiness, file.path(table_dir, "sensor_analysis_readiness.csv"))

weekly_scheme_route <- sensor_daily |>
  filter(period_model != "transition") |>
  group_by(
    scheme_id, scheme_label, road_group, route_group, imd_group, imd_decile,
    intervention_date, week_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sensor_days = n(),
    countlines_observed = n_distinct(countline_id),
    days_observed = n_distinct(date),
    pedestrian = sum(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyclist = sum(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    active_travel_total = sum(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    car = sum(car, na.rm = TRUE),
    active_per_countline_day = active_travel_total / sensor_days,
    cyclist_per_countline_day = cyclist / sensor_days,
    pedestrian_per_countline_day = pedestrian / sensor_days,
    period_model = if_else(first(week_date) < first(intervention_date), "pre", "post"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_scheme_route <- sensor_daily |>
  filter(period_model != "transition") |>
  group_by(
    scheme_id, scheme_label, road_group, route_group, imd_group, imd_decile,
    intervention_date, month_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sensor_days = n(),
    countlines_observed = n_distinct(countline_id),
    days_observed = n_distinct(date),
    pedestrian = sum(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyclist = sum(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    active_travel_total = sum(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    active_per_countline_day = active_travel_total / sensor_days,
    cyclist_per_countline_day = cyclist / sensor_days,
    pedestrian_per_countline_day = pedestrian / sensor_days,
    period_model = if_else(first(month_date) < first(intervention_date), "pre", "post"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(weekly_scheme_route, file.path(table_dir, "weekly_scheme_route_context_totals.csv"))
write_csv(monthly_scheme_route, file.path(table_dir, "monthly_scheme_route_context_totals.csv"))

pre_post_change <- sensor_daily |>
  filter(period_model %in% c("pre", "post")) |>
  group_by(scheme_id, scheme_label, route_group, imd_group, period_model) |>
  summarise(
    sensor_days = n(),
    active_per_countline_day = mean(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyclist_per_countline_day = mean(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    pedestrian_per_countline_day = mean(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period_model,
    values_from = c(
      sensor_days,
      active_per_countline_day,
      cyclist_per_countline_day,
      pedestrian_per_countline_day
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    active_abs_change = active_per_countline_day_post - active_per_countline_day_pre,
    active_pct_change = (active_per_countline_day_post / active_per_countline_day_pre - 1) * 100,
    cyclist_abs_change = cyclist_per_countline_day_post - cyclist_per_countline_day_pre,
    cyclist_pct_change = (cyclist_per_countline_day_post / cyclist_per_countline_day_pre - 1) * 100,
    pedestrian_abs_change = pedestrian_per_countline_day_post - pedestrian_per_countline_day_pre,
    pedestrian_pct_change = (pedestrian_per_countline_day_post / pedestrian_per_countline_day_pre - 1) * 100,
    has_pre_post = !is.na(sensor_days_pre) & !is.na(sensor_days_post)
  )

write_csv(pre_post_change, file.path(table_dir, "pre_post_daily_mean_change_by_scheme_route.csv"))

deprivation_summary <- sensor_daily |>
  group_by(imd_group, scheme_id, scheme_label, route_group) |>
  summarise(
    countlines = n_distinct(countline_id),
    lsoa21_areas = n_distinct(analysis_lsoa21cd),
    first_observed_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_observed_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_active_per_countline_day = mean(active_travel_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cyclist_per_countline_day = mean(cyclist, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pedestrian_per_countline_day = mean(pedestrian, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(deprivation_summary, file.path(table_dir, "deprivation_group_descriptive_summary.csv"))

plot_readiness <- scheme_readiness |>
  mutate(
    scheme_label = fct_reorder(scheme_label, imd_decile_min),
    analysis_use = factor(
      analysis_use,
      levels = c(
        "Exploratory pre/post ITS candidate",
        "Limited pre/post descriptive only",
        "Post-installation trajectory only",
        "Needs manual review"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(pre_calendar_days, post_calendar_days, colour = analysis_use, size = countlines)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scheme_id), nudge_y = 45, size = 3.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Exploratory pre/post ITS candidate" = "#0072B2",
      "Limited pre/post descriptive only" = "#E69F00",
      "Post-installation trajectory only" = "#D55E00",
      "Needs manual review" = "#6B7280"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scheme Readiness for Pre/Post Analysis",
    subtitle = "Based on reliable observed days before and after the intervention month",
    x = "Pre-intervention calendar days",
    y = "Post-intervention calendar days",
    colour = NULL,
    size = "Countlines"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "scheme_analysis_readiness.png"), plot_readiness, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

plot_monthly_mode <- monthly_scheme_route |>
  select(
    scheme_label, route_group, imd_group, month_date, intervention_date,
    cyclist_per_countline_day, pedestrian_per_countline_day
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cyclist_per_countline_day, pedestrian_per_countline_day),
    names_to = "mode",
    values_to = "daily_mean"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mode = recode(
      mode,
      cyclist_per_countline_day = "Cyclist",
      pedestrian_per_countline_day = "Pedestrian"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(month_date, daily_mean, colour = mode)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = intervention_date), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  facet_grid(imd_group ~ scheme_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean Daily Counts by Scheme, Mode, and Deprivation Group",
    subtitle = "Values are normalised per countline-day to reduce bias from different numbers of sensors",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean daily count per countline",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "monthly_mode_by_scheme_imd_group.png"), plot_monthly_mode, width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 300)

plot_weekly_active <- weekly_scheme_route |>

  ) +

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "weekly_active_travel_by_scheme_imd_group.png"), plot_weekly_active, width = 12, height = 14, dpi = 300)

plot_prepost <- pre_post_change |>
  filter(has_pre_post) |>
  mutate(scheme_route = paste(scheme_label, route_group, sep = "\n")) |>
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(scheme_route, active_pct_change), active_pct_change, fill = imd_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +

  ) +

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "descriptive_pre_post_change_by_scheme_route.png"), plot_prepost, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)

run_its <- function(data, outcome) {
  model_data <- data |>
    filter(period_model %in% c("pre", "post"), sensor_days > 0) |>
    arrange(week_date) |>
    mutate(
      week_index = as.numeric(difftime(week_date, min(week_date), units = "weeks")),
      post = as.integer(week_date >= intervention_date),
      week_after = pmax(0, as.numeric(difftime(week_date, intervention_date, units = "weeks"))),
      week_of_year = isoweek(week_date),
      sin52 = sin(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.18),
      cos52 = cos(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.18),
      outcome_value = .data[[outcome]]
    )

  if (sum(model_data$post == 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 8 ||
      sum(model_data$post == 1, na.rm = TRUE) < 12 ||
      sum(model_data$outcome_value, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      model_status = "not_enough_pre_post_weeks"
    ))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      outcome_value ~ week_index + post + week_after + sin52 + cos52 + offset(log(sensor_days)),
      family = quasipoisson(link = "log"),
      data = model_data
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      model_status = paste("model_error:", fit$message)
    ))
  }

  tidy(fit) |>
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome,
      model_status = "ok",
      rate_ratio = exp(estimate),
      conf_low = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      conf_high = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      n_weeks = nrow(model_data),
      pre_weeks = sum(model_data$post == 0),
      post_weeks = sum(model_data$post == 1)
    )
}

its_results <- weekly_scheme_route |>
  group_by(scheme_id, scheme_label, route_group, imd_group) |>
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(
    run_its(.x, "active_travel_total"),
    run_its(.x, "cyclist"),
    run_its(.x, "pedestrian")
  )) |>
  ungroup()

write_csv(its_results, file.path(table_dir, "exploratory_its_weekly_scheme_route_coefficients.csv"))

its_key_terms <- its_results |>
  filter(model_status == "ok", term %in% c("post", "week_after")) |>
  mutate(
    term_label = recode(
      term,
      post = "Immediate level change after intervention",
      week_after = "Weekly slope change after intervention"
    )
  )

write_csv(its_key_terms, file.path(table_dir, "exploratory_its_key_terms.csv"))

plot_its <- its_key_terms |>
  filter(outcome == "active_travel_total") |>
  mutate(scheme_route = paste(scheme_label, route_group, sep = "\n")) |>
  ggplot(aes(rate_ratio, fct_reorder(scheme_route, rate_ratio), colour = imd_group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ term_label, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "Exploratory Interrupted Time-Series Coefficients",
    subtitle = "Quasi-Poisson weekly models. Rate ratio above 1 suggests higher counts; not matched-control causal estimates.",
    x = "Rate ratio",
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

if (nrow(its_key_terms) > 0) {
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "exploratory_its_active_travel_rate_ratios.png"), plot_its, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
}

brief_path <- file.path(output_dir, "first_stage_analysis_brief.md")
brief <- c(
  "# First-Stage Analysis Brief",
  "",
  "## What this stage does",
  "",
  "This stage starts from the joined daily Vivacity + LSOA 2021 context table and prepares the first dissertation analysis outputs: scheme readiness, deprivation grouping, descriptive pre/post summaries, monthly/weekly plots, and exploratory interrupted time-series model tables.",
  "",
  "## Key methodological position",
  "",
  "The current analysis is suitable for descriptive trend comparison and exploratory pre/post modelling. It is not yet a full causal matched-control design because matched non-intervention sensor sites have not been added.",
  "",
  "## Scheme readiness",
  "",
  paste0("- ", scheme_readiness$scheme_id, " ", scheme_readiness$road_group, ": ", scheme_readiness$analysis_use, " (pre days: ", scheme_readiness$pre_calendar_days, "; post days: ", scheme_readiness$post_calendar_days, "; IMD: ", scheme_readiness$imd_groups, ")"),
  "",
  "## Outputs",
  "",
  paste0("- Tables: `", table_dir, "`"),
  paste0("- Plots: `", plot_dir, "`"),
  "",
  "## Recommended next step",
  "",
  "Use the readiness table to decide which schemes enter the main ITS chapter. Treat 12b and 12e as post-installation descriptive cases unless better pre-intervention data become available. Add matched non-intervention sensors before making stronger causal claims."
)
writeLines(brief, brief_path)

summary_json <- list(
  input_daily = input_daily,
  rows = nrow(sensor_daily),
  schemes = n_distinct(sensor_daily$scheme_id),
  countlines = n_distinct(sensor_daily$countline_id),
  lsoa21_areas = n_distinct(sensor_daily$analysis_lsoa21cd),
  pre_post_candidate_schemes = scheme_readiness |>
    filter(analysis_use == "Exploratory pre/post ITS candidate") |>
    pull(scheme_id),
  post_only_schemes = scheme_readiness |>
    filter(analysis_use == "Post-installation trajectory only") |>
    pull(scheme_id),
  output_dir = output_dir
)

jsonlite::write_json(summary_json, file.path(output_dir, "first_stage_analysis_summary.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)

message("First-stage analysis complete: ", output_dir)
```
